engine: Sidemantic unified semantic layer importing MetricFlow and Cube definitions

queries.orders.subtotal: SELECT orders.ordered_at, orders.subtotal FROM orders ORDER BY orders.ordered_at
queries.order_items.revenue: SELECT order_items.ordered_at, order_items.revenue FROM order_items ORDER BY order_items.ordered_at

compiled_sql.orders.subtotal:
WITH orders_cte AS (
  SELECT
    order_id AS order_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ordered_at) AS ordered_at,
    subtotal AS subtotal_raw
  FROM main.orders
)
SELECT
  orders_cte.ordered_at AS ordered_at,
  SUM(orders_cte.subtotal_raw) AS subtotal
FROM orders_cte
GROUP BY
  1
-- sidemantic: models=orders metrics=orders.subtotal dimensions=orders.ordered_at
compiled_sql.order_items.revenue:
WITH order_items_cte AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id AS order_item_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ordered_at) AS ordered_at,
    product_price AS revenue_raw
  FROM main.order_items
)
SELECT
  order_items_cte.ordered_at AS ordered_at,
  SUM(order_items_cte.revenue_raw) AS revenue
FROM order_items_cte
GROUP BY
  1
-- sidemantic: models=order_items metrics=order_items.revenue dimensions=order_items.ordered_at
